name: Cameron
source:
A snarky, boisterous guy Jace plays basketball with sometimes. Cameron's got a bad boy reputation at campus, but no one's sure where the rumours came from. Ignoring how he never seems to take off his sunglasses, Cameron drives a motorcycle and owns the world's cutest dog - what more could you with for in a guy? 

[From [url=https://teamfoxglove.itch.io/trouble-comes-twice]itch.io[/url]]
